comments.html: The cover looks awesome!! I can’t wait until the final book is released. I had the privilege of reading your beta draft and thought it was amazing. I said it before and I’ll say it again, these books are quite frankly some of the best Sci-fi I’ve read in a long time. You’re easily up there with the likes of Orson Scott Card, Frank Herbert and E.E Doc Smith. Keep it coming and I hope you have plenty more in store for us?

replies.html: Thanks much Garry. Glad you’ve enjoyed them. Don’t worry, I’ll keep them coming.
